## Contribution

Active packages require at least one stored OCP, diffusion or kinetics record. Full-cell tests are supporting links to those parameters; test-only sources remain research leads.

What changed, and how can a modeler use it? Link the related issue if applicable.

## Processing and verification

Link the completed `templates/data-contribution.md` for new data. Summarize
original/processed hashes, unit/sign/coordinate conversions, extraction commands
and deterministic reconstruction where applicable.

- Checks run and results:
- Checks not run and why:

## Review checklist

- [ ] Primary sources, exact locations and reuse terms are documented.
- [ ] Cell matches and coordinate/kinetic conventions are supported by evidence.
- [ ] Missing observations and unresolved identities remain explicit.
- [ ] Changes include applicable attribution, coverage and matching-audit updates.
- [ ] Applicable checks in `CONTRIBUTING.md` were run or omissions explained.

For documentation-only PRs, mark data-specific sections and checks as not
applicable. No new independent model validation is implied by this checklist.
